meta.title: Da Nang Tailor · Áo dài made in 24h, Han Market, Da Nang
meta.description: Da Nang Tailor inside Han Market, Da Nang. Áo dài made in 24h, plus modernised Vietnamese clothing and suits. Call +84 900 000 000.

sections.find: Finding the stall in Han Market

hero.line: Áo dài, modern Vietnamese wear and the occasional suit, made to measure at the stall.

story.p1: Da Nang Tailor is in Han Market, Da Nang.
story.p2: The tailor has given most of her working life to áo dài, alongside modern Vietnamese wear and, when a customer needs one, a suit. Every piece is measured at the stall and made to fit the person who will wear it.
story.p3: After {years} years in the trade, she still works the way she always has: listening to what you want, choosing the fabric with you, then sewing it until it fits just right.
story.p4: Her customers are Da Nang locals and visitors, most of them from Korea and Japan. Even with only a few days in Da Nang, many still find their way to the stall to have an áo dài made to take home.

process.step1Text: Tell her the style you want. Bring a photo if you have one.
process.step2Text: Pick the material and colour at the stall.
process.step3Text: She takes your measurements at the stall.
process.step4Text: Come back to the stall to try it on and collect it.
process.turnaround: Ready in 24–48h, depending on the garment.
process.fabricNote: The final price depends on the fabric you choose.
